recommendations.title: Refresh: Add step-by-step guide to check if you pay effect fee
recommendations.details: Add a concise step-by-step section on the page(s) explaining exactly how a villa owner can verify whether they are charged an effectavgift: where to find the network operator on the electricity bill, how to check the network operator’s price list or "Mina sidor", and which contract/ säkringsuppgifter to look for (e.g. huvudsäkring A). Include short screenshots or annotated examples of an elnätsfaktura and a sample phrasing from Ellevio confirming removal of the effectavgift.
suggestedSections: Hur kontrollerar jag om jag har effektavgift?
Var står nätägaren på min faktura?

recommendations.title: Refresh: Add publication date and verification note
recommendations.details: Add a clear publication/last-updated date and a short verification note on relevant pages stating that the regulatory situation can change and advising readers to confirm with their nätbolag. Include a one-line recommended action: "Kontrollera nätbolagets prislista eller Mina sidor för aktuell information."

recommendations.title: Create: Add FAQ and concrete examples of bill impact
recommendations.details: Create a short FAQ or example section (either as a new FAQ page or an expanded subsection) that shows simple numeric examples of how Ellevio’s two-part model affects monthly costs for common säkringsstorlekar (e.g. 16 A, 20 A, 25 A). Show before/after comparisons (with and without effektavgift) and a note about regional variation for other nätbolag.
